title: BACnet: update to protocol revision 24
description:
Added Support for Network Port Objects according to addendum 135-2020cc
Added Support for Color Objects according to addendum 135-2020ca
Added Support for Lighting Outputs trim command accodring to addendum 135-2020ca
Added Vendor IDs
Added new Error codes

[notes]
All Changes are limited to the bacnet dissector, individual commits might not be prefixed with BACnet:
Please feel free to merge as a single commit or as individual commits whatever looks preferable.

notes.body:
Can you fix

epan/dissectors/packet-bacapp.c:10171: trailing whitespace.

Dear Alexis La Goutte,

thanks for the response, it is fixed and committed on the branch I can
write to

https://gitlab.com/christoph_zeller_ch/wireshark.git

Do I need to update the merge request?

Thanks in advance

Christoph Zeller

Dear Alexis,

After fixing the tailing blank, I tried to rebase my commit,
from a codebase view, this was running smoothly.

However it seems to trigger a new problem in the building chain.

I tried to fix this by creating a new local branch <BACnet-rev24b> which
is clean.

How should I proceed.

Thanks in advance

Christoph Zeller

git rebase upstream/master (after add upstream repo)

Good morning Alexis,

my issue was pushing a rebased version to downstream,

I missed the + before head and git was telling me I cannot push because
I'm behind and told me to merge first.

I hope it now worked, at least the pipeline tells me "fixed"

Regards Christoph

Good morning Alexis,

the pipeline now says passed which I assume is a good sign.

Do I need to start another merge request?

Thanks in advance for your help

Christoph
